acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves that Proofloom creates and verifies an exact clean repository snapshot; it does not prove AgentFlow consumed or enforced it.
evidenceRequired: A clean governed fixture produces a v2 handoff bound to commit, authority state, governance report, source hashes, and aggregate snapshot digest.
Dirty worktree, changed commit, authority drift, missing source, changed source, and untracked authority tests fail closed.

completionCriteria: An execution-capable handoff records a clean Git base commit, worktree state, authority-state digest, governance-report digest, complete critical-source hashes, and aggregate snapshot digest.
Approved handoffs without current repository verification remain non-executable.
Any commit, worktree, authority, report, source-set, or source-content mismatch fails closed.
The CLI exposes repository-bound creation and validation without weakening proposed or review-required states.
nonObjectives: Do not execute AgentFlow from Proofloom.
Do not authorize execution from owner approval alone.
Do not treat a dirty or untracked snapshot as immutable evidence.
objective: Bind every executable AgentFlow handoff to the exact clean, converged repository authority snapshot.
title: Bind AgentFlow handoff v2 to the exact repository snapshot
